about: Sample rows from IRD's PAYE deduction tables IR340 and IR341 (April 2025 and April 2026 editions; URLs in src/lib/payroll/rates/). page is the printed page number. Main rows: earnings, M, ME, SL, KiwiSaver at the lowest rate then 4%, 6%, 8%, 10%, then net employer contribution and ESCT at 10.5%, 17.5%, 30%, 33% and 39% (employer contribution at the lowest rate). Secondary rows: earnings, SB, S, SH, ST, SA, SL, then the same KiwiSaver and ESCT columns.
